name: PEP 616 prefix strip is not lstrip

source.note: Minimized from bpo-39939 / PEP 616: str.removeprefix. The PEP exists because str.lstrip(prefix) treats the argument as a character set. Standalone helper; extra live turns ask the model to reuse it after distractor notes.

description: PEP 616 added str.removeprefix because the usual workaround s.lstrip(prefix) is wrong: lstrip takes a set of characters, not a literal prefix, so remove_prefix('test', 't') must return 'est' rather than stripping every leading t. Implement remove_prefix(s, prefix) so it returns s[len(prefix):] only when s.startswith(prefix), otherwise a copy of s. Empty prefix leaves the string unchanged. After the fix, later turns will ask you to reuse this helper on data/names.txt; do not switch back to lstrip.
extra_live_turns: Write src/notes.md with three unrelated observations about logging formatters and calendar rendering. Do not edit remove_prefix.py.
Add another short note to src/notes.md about timezone abbreviations. Still do not touch the prefix helper.
Using remove_prefix, write src/clean.py that prints each line of data/names.txt with the literal prefix tmp_ removed. Do not use str.lstrip.
